    The BGRS Figure 15 bound cleaving diagram #

    This file encodes the literal eight-vertex diagram of BGRS Figure 15. Its source is the free linear category modulo the single displayed relation alphaLeft ≫ delta ≫ alphaRight = 0.

    The explicit family has dimension vector (1,3,3,1,2,1,2,1). On the two three-dimensional central vertices the middle matrix is

      [1  1  0]
  [0  1  1]
  [1  c  1].

    The forbidden matrix entry is zero, so the bound relation holds. The flag maps on the two sides force a morphism between parameters c,d to have one scalar coefficient r; the remaining middle-arrow equation is c*r = d*r.
